column1: # German (de) catalog. Same format as `es.tsv`: context <TAB> source <TAB> translation.
# Clean-room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English label using ordinary
# German video-editing vocabulary. No proprietary localisation resource, string table or product UI
# was consulted or copied; add entries the same way. Text addresses the user informally ("du") and commands use the infinitive ("Projekt
# öffnen…"). Product, format and feature names (CFA4, Lumetri, Essential Graphics,
# EDL, AAF…) keep their spelling. The catalog covers the whole interface: first every menu,
# then the rest of the Spanish catalog (panels, dialogs,
# effects and their parameters, presets, settings, status messages). Strings added later show in
# English until they are translated.
# Terms: track = Spur, bin = Ablage, marker = Marker, playhead = Abspielposition, In/Out = In-/Out-
# Punkt, transition = Übergang, frame hold = Standbild, panel = Bedienfeld, workspace =
# Arbeitsbereich, label (colour) = Farbmarkierung, preferences =
# Voreinstellungen. "Timeline" is not translated. Further: frame = Frame, keyframe =
# Keyframe, preset = Vorgabe, footage = Material, render = rendern, application = Anwendung;
# ripple, roll, slip and slide edits keep their names (Ripple-Trimmen, Rollen-Werkzeug…); in
# Lumetri highlights = Lichter, shadows = Tiefen, midtones = Mitteltöne. Keys: Shift = Umschalt,
# Option = Wahl, Ctrl = Strg.

column2: Some codecs are free software but implement patented formats. Like Ubuntu, CFA4 does not install them by default: the base package works without them, and you decide whether to install them. Their use may be restricted in some countries; check that it is permitted where you are.

Wie Ubuntu installiert CFA4 sie nicht standardmäßig: Das Basispaket funktioniert ohne sie, und Sie entscheiden, ob Sie sie installieren. Ihre Nutzung kann in manchen Ländern eingeschränkt sein; prüfen Sie, ob sie bei Ihnen erlaubt ist.
